name: Neural Operator Learning
summary: Learn parametric nonlinear maps between function spaces rather than solve each ODE/PDE instance independently.
core_idea: Represent a family of solution operators through trainable integral/spectral/basis maps shared across discretizations.
innovation: Amortizes repeated forward solves and provides a framework unifying different function-to-function network architectures.
limitations: Reliable extrapolation to unfamiliar parameter or geometry regimes remains difficult.
Operator evaluations inherit numerical and training-data errors.
